title: A routed layer's CPU share joined inside a CUDA stream: the CPU tier's routes posted into a slot of one of the host's handoffs by one kernel, the CPU's rows scattered into the device part's route rows after the join by another, capture-safe

post.what: one block of 256 threads a layer call: the routes' ids and slots read into shared memory, thread 0 lists the CPU routes (slot -2) in route order and the tokens they read in first-use order, every thread copies those tokens' rows into the payload (as BF16-rounded FP32, the declared arithmetic's input), a system-scope fence, then thread 0 posts the slot or answers it itself when there is no CPU route

scatter.what: a block a CPU route after the join: the slot's status read once a block that has a route, the CPU's FP32 row copied into the device part's route row, NaN rows where the CPU failed (never a silent partial sum), the status word for the caller
